purpose: Descriptive audit of prespecified primary and replication; no outcome-based selection
improvement_sign: Positive means TRAIN-prior NLL minus model NLL: lower model loss is better

definitions.pooled: Each admitted known root has equal weight
definitions.equal_day: Each of ten TEST days has equal weight; all rows within a sampled day stay together
definitions.both: State 3: both LONG and SHORT fixed crossing events can occur within the horizon; neither side is a mutually exclusive binary complement
definitions.direction: Conditional three-way LONG_ONLY/SHORT_ONLY/BOTH; scored only where fixed crossing event is positive
definitions.temporal: Existing artifact differences across same-support adjacent known roots; target flip and probability total variation are not loss gradients

equal_day_joint_nll_bootstrap.inference: descriptive only; adjacent days may be dependent; only ten TEST days; no correction for historical exposure or model-selection uncertainty

validation_prior_posthoc_diagnostic.fitted_from: Only known feature-available VALIDATION labels; additive 0.5 per class; no TEST fitting
validation_prior_posthoc_diagnostic.role: Posthoc diagnostic of prevalence/intercept adaptation, not the prespecified benchmark and never used for model/checkpoint/risk selection

equal_day_joint_nll_bootstrap.inference: descriptive only; adjacent days may be dependent; only ten TEST days; no correction for historical exposure or model-selection uncertainty

validation_prior_posthoc_diagnostic.event_auc_note: A constant prior has event AUC 0.5 on a two-class cohort. Model AUC measures ranking and is not improved merely by shifting a constant intercept; changing conditional populations can still change AUC.

independent_saved_probability_derivative.definition: Recompute unreduced BCE gradient pE-yE and conditional CE softmax-minus-onehot L2 from saved probabilities; NONE direction gradient is zero. Float32 probability roundtrip tolerance 2e-6.

test_head_difficulty.scope: TEST known feature-available roots; diagnostics only, no loss or fit changed
test_head_difficulty.event_definition: E true probability is pE for positive Y, 1-pE for NONE; pE=1-p_none; mass is absolute saved dL/dz_event
test_head_difficulty.direction_definition: D true probability is p_true_joint/pE only for positive Y (three-way LONG_ONLY/SHORT_ONLY/BOTH); mass is saved conditional-direction gradient L2. Tiny float32 roundtrip deviations are clipped to [0,1].
test_head_difficulty.caution: Existing joint-probability difficulty groups remain unchanged. Joint-hard does not imply conditional-direction-hard; separate head probabilities are needed to discuss focal loss.

gradients.mass_definition: Actual unreduced configured dL_i/dlogit: absolute event gradient and direction L2 mass. Difficulty partitions use true joint probability; event/class groups overlap those partitions.

train_test_prevalence.cohort: feature_available and known fixed crossing labels

paired_risk.kind: oracle paired independent trial diagnostic, not account/policy/equity
paired_risk.cohort: feature_available AND known fixed crossing AND both sides COMPLETE in all plans; identical roots for cost2/4/6
paired_risk.event: Fixed G_event; only stop R_trade changes. Positive retention means actual exit net > 0 conditional on true LONG/SHORT crossing label.
paired_risk.units: USD per reference ounce; decision-cost ratio is a proxy based on origin spread, not entry spread

crossing_multiplicity.definition: On feature-available known roots, count each positive LONG and SHORT label against its saved first_qualifying_event_id. BOTH contributes one root-side label to each side. Per-ID quantiles weight distinct saved IDs equally; top-1 share divides the largest ID multiplicity by positive root-side labels. Scale/line is joined by exact ID to saved crossing banks: role 0 lower, 1 middle, 2 upper; it describes the first qualifying witness, not every future crossed line.
crossing_multiplicity.training_usage: The frozen baseline samples uniform roots. Saved event IDs are not used for loss weighting, cooldown, or sampling.
crossing_multiplicity.witness_tie_rule: The saved target chooses the smallest qualifying publication ordinal; same-ordinal ties follow ascending scale then line role. Witness-scale shares are not an ablation of larger-scale information.
crossing_multiplicity.limitation: Saved IDs describe repeated assignment to a crossing. Unique ID counts are not effective sample sizes or counts of statistically independent events; different crossings may share market paths.

actual_context_history.definition: Reproduce FeatureStore.segment_starts exactly on every origin before filtering known Y: reset on date/cadence gap, segment-token change, or unavailable current/previous X. Real tokens=i-start+1; actual TCN tokens=min(real,supplied64,RF61); elapsed=(actual_tokens-1)*5s. Unknown labels do not reset history.
actual_context_history.reset_counts_caution: Cause counts overlap. Token changes combine source capture/epoch/1s gap/admission and quote epoch/invalid/60s gap; these are not automatically physical quote support failures.
source_code_findings: features.asof_source starts a source segment after any endpoint step !=1s, capture/epoch change, or inadmissible source row (including recovery).
full_history.generate_features admission additionally requires available_ns-t_ns<=1s, even if the canonical second's book is valid.

finalize_market._second_rows creates one-second rows and publishes them at max(endpoint,next raw receive time); an ordinary quiet interval can therefore produce late rows and an admission-driven sequence reset without proving a quote support loss.

This is a conservative representation boundary. Five minutes is the maximum receptive field, not the typical supplied detailed context. No frozen features, segments, runs or fits are changed by this audit.

bounded_source_witness.conclusion: This exact source-admission reset happens while the bounded canonical quote slice remains supported: a valid second published 1.215s late becomes inadmissible under the source 1s publication-delay rule. It demonstrates conservative fragmentation, not a physical quote support break.
bounded_source_witness.generalization_limit: One verified witness; the share of all resets attributable to this mechanism was not measured. Do not describe it as the dominant cause without a full attribution audit.

caveats: Ten adjacent days and a single GCM6 contract do not prove robustness across regimes/contracts.
These dates are new relative to scientific-v1 but some were inspected in older repository experiments.
Bootstrap is descriptive, not a significance certificate; no independent-day or stationarity claim.
Classification NLL, crossing retention, and after-cost sequential policy are distinct claims.
